message: this file has no `# proto-file:` and `# proto-message:` header
fix: start the file with `# proto-file: <schema path>` and `# proto-message: <Message>`: a path relative to this file, or a `//` path
notes: a text format file a build reads is checked against its message before any generator reads it

message: `b` and `a` both use field number 1
fix: give each field of a message its own number
notes: a number is what names a field on the wire, and a name what names it in JSON, so a second use would read as the first field

message: an extension or `Any` field, written `[name]`, is not supported
fix: write the message's own fields
notes: a `.proto` schema here declares no extensions, and an `Any` would name a type the schema does not

message: `# proto-import:` is not supported
fix: delete the line: `# proto-file:` names the schema, and its own imports bring the rest
notes: the text format's specification gives it no meaning, so nothing reads it the same way twice
